name: AI-READY INJECTOR
description: Injects and maintains machine-readable signals at the edge for existing websites. Execution half of the 3webobs observer and injector executor pair.

skills.name: Build an injection plan
skills.description: Takes an audit report from 3webobs and returns the ordered set of corrections, each tagged with its automation tier.
skills.note: Public endpoint ships with the secured API.

skills.name: Apply an injection plan
skills.description: Executes the automatic tier at the edge for a tenant domain. The approval tier is queued for human confirmation and never applied autonomously.
skills.note: Public endpoint ships with the secured API.
